mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_name AS shopName, address, phone, business_status AS businessStatus, notice FROM merchant_shop WHERE business_status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT s.id, s.shop_name AS shopName, s.address, s.phone, s.business_status AS businessStatus, s.notice, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.id) AS categoryCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS dishCount, COALESCE(MIN(d.price), 0) AS minPrice, COALESCE( SUBSTRING_INDEX( GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.dish_name ORDER BY d.id SEPARATOR '、'), '、', 3 ), '' ) AS featuredDishes FROM merchant_shop s LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON dc.shop_id = s.id AND dc.status = 1 LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.shop_id = s.id AND d.status = 1 WHERE s.business_status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.shop_name, s.address, s.phone, s.business_status, s.notice ORDER BY s.id ASC
